description: Synthetic, template-generated binary supervised data for Laya choice fine-tuning using INDIAN/NOT_INDIAN expected choices. Former ambiguous cases are mapped to NOT_INDIAN because they do not establish a current Indian affiliation. Human review is required before treating labels as gold data.

policy.INDIAN: Sufficient evidence that the current institution or campus is in India.
policy.NOT_INDIAN: No sufficient evidence that the current institution or campus is in India.
policy.ignore: Nationality, email addresses, former affiliations, and India as a subject/department do not establish current Indian location.
policy.overseas_campus: Classify the current campus location, not the parent institution's country.

conversion_rule: original_label=ambiguous -> expected=NOT_INDIAN; positive -> expected=INDIAN; negative -> expected=NOT_INDIAN

affiliation_geography.instructions: Does this affiliation provide sufficient evidence that the current institution or campus is located in India?

criteria.INDIAN: Sufficient evidence that the current institution or campus is in India.
criteria.NOT_INDIAN: No sufficient evidence that the current institution or campus is in India.

limitations: Synthetic templates are not a representative sample of scholarly affiliations.
The same institution families appear across splits; this measures policy coverage, not unseen-entity generalization.
Binary negative includes unresolved evidence, so the negative class is intentionally broader than foreign-only affiliations.
Review every label and remove generated near-duplicates before publication or high-stakes training.
